w ∈ S R δ M m → w * blk R δ M m j ∈ S R δ M (m + 1)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.span_mul_mem {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M : ℕ} {s : Set (TemperleyLieb.TLFin R δ M)} {T : Submodule R (TemperleyLieb.TLFin R δ M)} {r : TemperleyLieb.TLFin R δ M} (h : ∀ z ∈ s, z * r ∈ T) (w : TemperleyLieb.TLFin R δ M) :

z * blk R δ M m j ∈ NFset R δ M (m + 1)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.exists_append_block {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M : ℕ} (x : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
NFr x → ∀ (a j γ : ℕ), (∀ q ∈ x, q.1 < a) → a < M → j ≤ a + 1 → (∀ q ∈ x, q.2 < γ) → j ≤ γ → ∃ (y : List (ℕ × ℕ)), NFr y ∧ (∀ q ∈ y, q.1 ≤ a) ∧ (∀ q ∈ y, q.2 < γ + 2) ∧ prodR R δ M x * blk R δ M a j = prodR R δ M y

blk R δ M m j * E R δ M k = blk R δ M (k - 2) j * blk R δ M m k

blk R δ M m j * E R δ M (j + 1) = blk R δ M m (j + 1)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.blk_mul_E_down {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) :

blk R δ M m j * E R δ M k = E R δ M k * blk R δ M m j

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.blk_empty {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M : ℕ} (a : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.blk_self {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M : ℕ} (a : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.blk_ins {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M a' b' a j : ℕ} (h1 : a' < a) (h2 : j ≤ b') (h3 : b' ≤ a') (hM : a < M) :

runL R δ M (z + c) (d + 1) * runL R δ M z (c + d + 2) = runL R δ M z (c + d + 1) * runL R δ M (z + c + 2) d

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.blkL_G {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M : ℕ} (y d : ℕ) :
y + d + 1 < M → runL R δ M y (d + 1) * runL R δ M y (d + 2) = runL R δ M y (d + 1) * runL R δ M (y + 2) d

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalFormSpanning.runL_succ {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {δ : R} {M : ℕ} (y d : ℕ) :
